programme.title: Bachelor of Computer Science - 2027
programme.degree: Bachelor of Computer Science (2559), 3 years, St Lucia; Semester 1 (22 Feb, 2027) or Semester 2 (26 Jul, 2027)
programme.how_found: web search restricted to uq.edu.au (discovery only) -> study.uq.edu.au programme page.
programme.notes: Official domain uq.edu.au (missing from the kb_top100_list row). The programme page itself carries English, fee, closing date and a scholarship link for international students.

english.quote: IELTS overall 6.5; reading 6; writing 6; speaking 6; listening 6. For other English Language Proficiency Tests and Scores approved for UQ TOEFL iBT (including Paper Edition) - Overall 87, listening 19, reading 19, writing 21 and speaking 19.
english.notes: Programme page, 'English language requirements'. Also PTE Academic overall 64 with 60 in all sub bands. OET not accepted.

gpa.notes: The 'Minimum entry score' depends on the qualification selected in an interactive selector ('Use the minimum entry score as a guide'); no figure for a non-Australian qualification was readable in the static page. Prerequisites: Queensland Year 12 General English and Mathematical Methods (Units 3 & 4, C) or equivalent.

deadline.quote: If you're applying to UQ , the closing date for this program is: To commence study in semester 2 - May 31 of the year of commencement. To commence study in semester 1 - November 30 of the previous year.
deadline.notes: International (direct application to UQ) route; Year 12 in Australia applies via QTAC. Semester 1 2027 start -> 30 November 2026; Semester 2 2027 -> 31 May 2027. The rule is printed without a year (relative to the year of commencement).

tuition.quote: Approximate yearly cost of tuition (16 units). Your fees will vary according to your study load. Fees are reviewed each year and may increase. AUD $60,952 2027
tuition.notes: International view of the 'Fees and Scholarships' section, indicative annual fee for 2027 (Australian academic year = calendar year). The domestic view shows $8,355 for 2026 (CSP).

scholarship_exists.quote: Scholarship value 20% reduction in tuition fees per semester Scholarship duration For the duration of the program
scholarship_exists.notes: PARTIAL (tuition reduction 20%), competitive ('have achieved a competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders'); for students commencing in 2027; T&Cs 2027 PDF on the page. Other UQ awards for internationals: UQ International Excellence Scholarship (25%), UQ Faculty International Scholarship (10%) - not read.

scholarship_international.quote: You're eligible if you: are an international student . And you: have applied to study full-time at UQ commencing in 2027 in an eligible program.
scholarship_international.notes: Student type: International; undergraduate and postgraduate coursework.
